---
title: "Average Session Length (Hours)"
date: "19/10/2026"
output: html_document
---

This report analyzes how long users stay active in each session during the year.

```{r}
# Load the dataset
avg_length <- read.csv("avg_SessionsLength_no_more_than_24h_.csv")

# Load libraries
library(ggplot2)

# Convert columns
avg_length$date <- as.Date(avg_length$date, format = "%Y-%m-%d")
avg_length$avg_session_minutes <- as.numeric(avg_length$avg_session_minutes)
avg_length$avg_session_hours <- as.numeric(avg_length$avg_session_hours)

# Clean data
avg_length <- avg_length[is.finite(avg_length$avg_session_hours), ]

# Plot with trend line
ggplot(avg_length, aes(x = date, y = avg_session_hours)) +
  geom_line(color = "blue", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(color = "darkred", size = 2) +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", se = FALSE, color = "green", linewidth = 1.2) +
  labs(
    title = "Average Session Length (Hours) Over Time",
    x = "Date",
    y = "Average Session Length (Hours)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
